findings.title: instrumental proof medium
findings.claim: The preposition bi makes the demanded warrant the means by which the challenge is answered, so the ayah asks for proof-bearing production rather than a bare assertion.
findings.mechanism: The preposition directly governs the noun sulṭān; that instrumental link turns the proof into the required medium of response.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the phrase asks for a warrant as an instrument, not merely for something called evidence.
findings.containment: This is the local force of the preposition in the proof clause; it does not add a separate claim about every use of bi.

findings.reader_payoff: The missing answer becomes a concrete warrant with authoritative force, not an abstract demand for power.
findings.containment: The proof frame narrows authority to a probative warrant while retaining its force; no general political meaning is asserted.
